Direct F814W measurement for M81-1. e_R is the reported ML statistical error; the adopted Freedman (2021) zero point introduces shared calibration uncertainty. The error range is used considering they report asymmetric errors.

Direct F814W measurement for M81-2. The result agrees with M81-1 within errors; spatial selection reduces young-star, AGB and RHeB contamination. The error range is used considering they report asymmetric errors.

M81-2 NIR remeasurement. Its uncertainty is considerably larger than for M81-1. The value is tied to the common F814W anchor and is not geometrically independent. The error range is used considering they report asymmetric errors.

M81-2 F160W result. It agrees with both F814W fields within errors and provides an internal test rather than an independent distance anchor. The error range is used considering they report asymmetric errors.

M81-1 NIR remeasurement using the new color calibration. It is tied to F814W and is an internal validation, with shared calibration covariance across fields. The error range is used considering they report asymmetric errors.

M81-1 F160W result. Agreement with the optical modulus supports the NIR calibration, but this measurement inherits the common F814W distance scale. The error range is used considering they report asymmetric errors.
